# RV2-A pre-registration (generated by run_rv2a.py prereg; written before any confirmatory seed ran)

Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-routing-v2-design.md` section 4. Arms: `A_new` = M0's frozen A settings with `arm_monitor_after_infancy=True` and `batch_vote=False`; `A_vote` = the same with `batch_vote=True` (`batch_vote_share=0.5`, `batch_vote_min=8`). Confirmatory seeds 20-39; dev seeds 100-102; batch 64.

## Training budgets (steps per batch, chosen on dev seeds; frozen by hash)

| Arm | func | perm | types |

| A_new (M2-A) | 5 | 20 | 125 |
| A_vote | 5 | 20 | 200 |

## Decision rule (verbatim from the spec)

Adopt the plain vote iff V1 and every guard pass (V2 and V3 are recorded, not gating); else run the restricted vote (a sample moves only if the modal expert's own gate accepts it) as the fallback on the same seeds and adopt it iff it passes V1 and every guard; else neither. V1 failing means the contamination mechanism claim was wrong: stop, re-diagnose, stage 3 is not started on this premise.
